title: Bazinga
blurb: Sheldon Cooper meant it sincerely; the internet did not. Jim Parsons' catchphrase from The Big Bang Theory has completed the full journey from prime-time sitcom punchline to universal cringe artefact, and is now used almost exclusively to mock the very idea of having a catchphrase. The correct deployment is after the worst possible joke, ideally one that landed in total silence, ideally your own. It also works as a self-aware apology for a pun nobody asked for. Few words carry this much accumulated irony in seven letters.
origin: Sheldon Cooper's catchphrase from The Big Bang Theory, adopted ironically.
